title: Austin: documenting a preservation-bonus rule
legal_date_label: Adoption and effective date stated in the notice
summary: The adopted rule adds Building Criteria Manual subsection 4.4.9, covering approval, submissions and documentation for preservation-bonus projects. The notice says the adopted text is unchanged from the proposed rule.
review: Use the captured section to locate the official rule, then review the notice and attached requirements before evaluating a project. A first capture establishes a baseline; it does not prove JurisMon detected a before-and-after amendment.

title: San Bernardino: reviewing a multi-topic ordinance
legal_date_label: Effective date stated on the county listing
summary: Ordinance 4400 addresses several Development Code topics, including accessory dwelling units, landscaping and hillside grading. Its introductory guide identifies the sections affected, helping a reviewer locate the relevant provisions in the official ordinance.
review: Find the captured ordinance, inspect the referenced sections and check the current county code before relying on a historic provision. This is a historical source-document example, not evidence that the 2021 ordinance remains the latest applicable law.
